pairs: Misit ergo Dominus Nathan ad David:
Then the Lord sent Nathan to David.
And when he had come to him,
Duo viri erant in civitate una,
Dives habebat oves et boves plurimos valde.
The wealthy man had very many sheep and oxen.
But the poor man had nothing at all,
præter ovem unam parvulam quam emerat et nutrierat,
except one little sheep, which he had bought and nourished.
et quæ creverat apud eum cum filiis ejus simul,
And she had grown up before him, together with his children,
And she was like a daughter to him.
Cum autem peregrinus quidam venisset ad divitem,
But when a certain traveler had come to the wealthy man,
neglecting to take from his own sheep and oxen,
so that he might present a feast for that traveler,
ut exhiberet convivium peregrino illi qui venerat ad se,
he took the sheep of the poor man,
et præparavit cibos homini qui venerat ad se.
and he prepared a meal for the man who had come to him.”
Iratus autem indignatione David adversus hominem illum nimis,
Then David’s indignation was enraged exceedingly against that man,
quoniam filius mortis est vir qui fecit hoc.
the man who has done this is a son of death.
He shall restore the sheep fourfold,
and he did not take pity.”
Thus says the Lord, the God of Israel:
Ego unxi te in regem super Israël,
‘I anointed you as king over Israel,
et ego erui te de manu Saul,
and I rescued you from the hand of Saul.
et dedi tibi domum domini tui,
And I gave the house of your lord to you,
et uxores domini tui in sinu tuo,
and the wives of your lord into your bosom.
dedique tibi domum Israël et Juda:
And I gave the house of Israel and of Judah to you.
And as if these things were small,
I shall add much greater things to you.
Therefore, why have you despised the word of the Lord,
ut faceres malum in conspectu meo? Uriam Hethæum percussisti gladio,
so that you did evil in my sight? You have struck down Uriah the Hittite with the sword.
et uxorem illius accepisti in uxorem tibi,
And you have taken his wife as a wife for yourself.
et interfecisti eum gladio filiorum Ammon.
And you have put him to death with the sword of the sons of Ammon.
Quam ob rem non recedet gladius de domo tua usque in sempiternum,
For this reason, the sword shall not withdraw from your house, even perpetually,
et tuleris uxorem Uriæ Hethæi ut esset uxor tua.
and you have taken the wife of Uriah the Hittite, so that she may be your wife.’
And so, thus says the Lord: ‘Behold,
Ecce ego suscitabo super te malum de domo tua,
I will raise up over you an evil from your own house.
et tollam uxores tuas in oculis tuis,
And I will take your wives away before your eyes,
et dabo proximo tuo: et dormiet cum uxoribus tuis in oculis solis hujus.
and I will give them to your neighbor. And he will sleep with your wives in the sight of this sun.
ego autem faciam verbum istud in conspectu omnis Israël,
But I will do this word in the sight of all of Israel,
and in the sight of the sun.’”
“The Lord has also taken away your sin.
Verumtamen quoniam blasphemare fecisti inimicos Domini,
Yet truly, because you have given occasion to the enemies of the Lord to blaspheme,
the son who was born to you:
Et reversus est Nathan in domum suam.
And Nathan returned to his own house.
Percussit quoque Dominus parvulum quem pepererat uxor Uriæ David,
And the Lord struck the little one, whom the wife of Uriah had borne to David,
Deprecatusque est David Dominum pro parvulo:
And David begged the Lord on behalf of the little one.
Then the elders of his house came,
cogentes eum ut surgeret de terra:
urging him to rise up from the ground.
nor would he eat a meal with them.
Accidit autem die septima ut moreretur infans:
Then, on the seventh day, it happened that the infant died.
timueruntque servi David nuntiare ei quod mortuus esset parvulus:
And the servants of David were afraid to report to him that the little one had died.
“Behold, when the child was still alive,
but he would not listen to our voice.
How much more will he afflict himself,
if we tell him that the boy is dead?”
Cum ergo David vidisset servos suos mussitantes,
But when David had seen his servants whispering,
he realized that the infant had died.
And he said to his servants,
Therefore, David rose up from the ground.
And he washed and anointed himself.
And when he had changed his clothing,
he entered the house of the Lord,
Then he went to his own house,
and he asked them to place bread before him,
But his servants said to him:
“What is this word that you have done?
But when the boy was dead,
and wept on behalf of the infant.
Quis scit si forte donet eum mihi Dominus,
Who knows if the Lord may perhaps give him to me,
But now that he is dead,
Would I be able to bring him back anymore?
Instead, I will go to him.
ille vero non revertetur ad me.
Yet truly, he will not return to me.”
Et consolatus est David Bethsabee uxorem suam,
And David consoled his wife Bathsheba.
ingressusque ad eam dormivit cum ea:
And entering to her, he slept with her.
and he called his name Solomon,
And he sent, by the hand of Nathan the prophet,
Igitur pugnabat Joab contra Rabbath filiorum Ammon,
And then Joab fought against Rabbah of the sons of Ammon,
and he fought outside the royal city.
And Joab sent messengers to David,
and so the City of Waters will soon be seized.
Nunc igitur congrega reliquam partem populi,
Now therefore, gather the remaining portion of the people together,
et obside civitatem, et cape eam:
and besiege the city and take it. Otherwise,
ne cum a me vastata fuerit urbs,
when the city will have been laid waste by me,
the victory will be ascribed to my name.”
And so David gathered together all the people,
and he set out against Rabbah.
Et tulit diadema regis eorum de capite ejus,
And he took the crown of their king from his head.
pondo auri talentum, habens gemmas pretiosissimas:
The weight of it was a talent of gold, having the most precious gems.
et impositum est super caput David.
And it was placed upon the head of David. Moreover,
Sed et prædam civitatis asportavit multam valde:
he carried away the spoils of the city, which were very many.
Also, bringing forth its people, he sawed them,
et circumegit super eos ferrata carpenta: divisitque cultris,
and he drove over them with iron wagons, and he divided them with knives,
and he dragged them through brick kilns.
sic fecit universis civitatibus filiorum Ammon.
So he did to all the citizens of the sons of Ammon.
Et reversus est David et omnis exercitus in Jerusalem.
And David returned, with the entire army, to Jerusalem.
